package.name: turtlebot_hardware
package.description:
TurtleBot AMR hardware interface for ros2_control.
This package provides: - C++ hardware interface plugin for differential drive - Serial communication with motor controller - Encoder reading and velocity command writing - Controller configuration (diff_drive_controller)
LEARNING OBJECTIVES (builds on learning_lifecycle): - Understand ros2_control hardware interface lifecycle - See how command/state interfaces work - Learn controller manager architecture - Practice C++ in ROS2 (minimal adapter pattern)
The hardware interface uses lifecycle callbacks: - on_init: Parse URDF parameters - on_configure: Open serial port - on_activate: Start communication - on_deactivate: Stop communication
